claims.claim: Capital One closed its acquisition of Discover on May 18, 2025, making PULSE Capital One-owned; the 10-K groups PULSE into a 'Global Payment Network' with Discover Network, Diners Club and Network Partners.
claims.quote: On May 18, 2025 (the “Closing Date”), Discover Financial Services (“Discover”) merged into Capital One and Discover Bank merged into CONA.
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Reach: ownership change. Prior owner Discover Financial Services (2020 to May 2025).

claims.claim: Capital One's 10-K defines PULSE as an EFT network giving debit issuers ATM access domestically and internationally plus U.S. merchant acceptance.
claims.quote: The PULSE Network operates an electronic funds transfer network, providing financial institutions issuing debit cards on the PULSE Network with access to ATMs
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Reach: scope definition; sentence continues 'domestically and internationally, as well as merchant acceptance throughout the U.S. for debit card transactions.'

claims.claim: Capital One reports Global Payment Network volume of $401,775 million for 2025 but does not break out PULSE volume separately.
claims.quote: Global Payment Network volume includes transactions processed on the Discover Network, PULSE Network, Diners Club and Network Partners.
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Reach: volume. Table shows 'Global Payment Network volume (3) 401,775' (USD millions, 2025; N/A prior years). PULSE-only figure not published.

claims.claim: The 10-K flags that PULSE merchants are largely not contractually committed and that competitor routing strategies may hurt PULSE volume, a Reg II-driven risk statement.
claims.quote: merchant and acquirer transaction routing strategies may adversely affect our recently acquired PULSE Network’s business practices, network transaction volume, revenue and prospects
claims.title: Capital One Financial Corporation Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Reach/risk. Also: 'small- and mid-size merchants, are not contractually committed to us for any period of time'.

claims.claim: PULSE positions itself as an independent debit network operating for more than 45 years, with partner brands Diners Club International and Discover Network plus global Alliance Partners.
claims.quote: PULSE ® is a leading debit network that has been delivering exceptional value, choice, and convenience across the payments ecosystem for more than 45 years.
claims.title: About PULSE | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Reach: brand family. Page also says 'our partner brands, Diners Club International ® and Discover ® Network, and our global Alliance Partners'. Still headlined 'An independent, forward-thinking debit network'; no Capital One mention on page.

claims.claim: PULSE corporate office is at 1301 McKinney Street, Suite 600, Houston, Texas 77010; phone hours are 8am to 5pm CT weekdays.
claims.quote: PULSE Corporate Office 1301 McKinney Street Suite 600 Houston, Texas 77010 (800) 420-2122
claims.title: Client Support | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Reach: HQ. Sales line (800) 543-3695, 'available 8am – 5pm CT, Monday through Friday'.

claims.claim: PULSE powers the U.S. and global ATM network for Discover, Diners Club International and Discover Debit cards, giving PULSE ATM acquirers exclusive access to those cards.
claims.quote: PULSE powers the U.S. and global ATM network for Discover, Diners Club International, Discover Debit and other international issuers.
claims.title: About PULSE | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Reach: ATM acquirers page adds 'exclusive access to Discover ® credit, Discover Debit, and Diners Club International ® cards'.

claims.claim: PULSE claims issuer access to more than 400,000 U.S. ATMs; no participant, card or transaction counts are published on the site.
claims.quote: Offer cardholders access to over 400,000 ATMs across the U.S. with competitive interchange and transaction fees.
claims.title: PULSE ATM Network | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Reach: ATMs. Same figure phrased '400,000 ATMs' on atm-acquirers page and 'more than 400,000 domestic ATMs' (for Discover) on discover-debit page; consistent. Discover Debit page separately cites '1.8 million ATMs and cash access locations around the world' for Discover cardholders. Issuer count given only as 'thousands of U.S. financial institution relationships'.

claims.claim: PULSE supports both single- and dual-message formats across PULSE PAY Express, e-commerce and mobile; PIN debit with PULSE PAY is the core card-present product.
claims.quote: Single and dual-message format capabilities No cardholder verification for transactions of $50 or less Cardholder verification supported for transactions over $50
claims.title: PULSE Payments Network | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Reach: message format. Services catalogue on this page: PIN Debit with PULSE PAY, PINless Debit with PULSE PAY Express, Mobile Payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay), PULSE E-Commerce, PINless Bill Pay, Account Credit Transfers (P2P/B2C), Fraud Detection & Analytics.

claims.claim: PULSE Side-by-Side (SXS) Token Service is a patented service routing tokenised card-on-file debit over PULSE and other enabled unaffiliated networks, pitched as Reg II CNP compliance.
claims.quote: allows tokenized card-on-file (COF) debit transactions to be routed over the PULSE Network and any other SXS Token Service enabled unaffiliated network.
claims.title: PULSE Payments Network | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Services: tokenisation. Benefits list includes 'Provides compliance with Regulation II, card-not-present (CNP) clarification'.

claims.claim: PULSE Gateway Services offers single-point access, one message format and single-point settlement to 13 named ATM/POS networks including STAR, NYCE, Interlink, Maestro, PLUS, Cirrus, MoneyPass and Allpoint.
claims.quote: Gain access to: AllPoint, Armed Forces Financial Network, Cirrus, Co-Op, Discover ® Network, Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT), Interlink, Maestro, MoneyPass, NYCE, PAVD, PLUS, and STAR.
claims.title: Debit Processing and Gateways | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Services: gateway (value-added, direct to issuers/processors). Features: 'Single-point exception item processing', 'Surcharge-free ATM option through MoneyPass', 'Single-point settlement for most networks', 'Transactions are monitored in DebitProtect'.

claims.claim: PULSE Debit Solutions provides full-service signature debit processing for Discover Debit, Mastercard and Visa programs, plus on-behalf-of validation services (CVV2/CVC2, AVS, EMV, PIN).
claims.quote: We provide full-service processing for Discover ® Debit, Mastercard and Visa debit card programs, all through a single point of access.
claims.title: Debit Processing and Gateways | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Services: processing (value-added). Also 'Enhanced chargeback services', 'Card production support', 'ATM terminal driving' (issuers page).

claims.claim: DebitProtect fraud detection, built on FICO Falcon, is included for all PULSE participants (core); Authorization Blocking is the premium tier with dedicated analyst and custom rules.
claims.quote: DebitProtect is included for all PULSE participants.
claims.title: Fraud Detection and Risk Mitigation | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Services: fraud. 'Technology powered by FICO ® Falcon ® with custom functionality from PULSE'; Authorization Blocking: 'Self-service emergency rules to fight after-hours fraud—without a fee'. Gated: 'Already a client? Register your users.'

claims.claim: Partner Support Services bundles Debit Dashboard analytics, DebitProtect, Marketing Hub, full disputes support, and research/advocacy (Debit Issuer Study, Voice of the Client Survey).
claims.quote: Debit Dashboard is an interactive platform that provides insight into your transaction data.
claims.title: Partner Support Services | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Services: data, disputes, marketing. Advocacy groups named: EMVCo, US Payments Forum, US Faster Payments Council, American Transaction Processing Coalition, FIDO Alliance, Merchant Advisory Group.

claims.claim: Discover Debit is a signature debit programme for community banks and credit unions with an all-in program fee, one-page invoice, ABA endorsement and bundled Experian cardholder benefits.
claims.quote: Our easy to understand All-in Program Fee structure delivers highly competitive interchange and reduced expenses, allowing you to keep more of your non-interest income.
claims.title: Discover Debit | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Services: issuer licensing programme (direct). 'Endorsed by the American Bankers Association'; 'All Discover Debit issuers receive access to the Marketing Hub'; 'Get a Debit Advantage Analysis' lead form.

claims.claim: For ATM acquirers PULSE offers the domestic ATM network, access to PULSE issuers plus international partner networks and exclusive Discover/Diners cards, and MoneyPass surcharge-free connectivity.
claims.quote: Connect with MoneyPass ® surcharge-free networks and give cardholders free access to cash.
claims.title: ATM Acquirers | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Services: ATM operator catalogue. Fees not published; 'competitive interchange and transaction fees' only.

claims.claim: Merchant services are PIN debit (PULSE PAY), PINless (PULSE PAY Express), E-Commerce and mobile with routing choice; PULSE claims some merchants saw a 10-point authorization-rate improvement.
claims.quote: Working with us, some merchants have seen a 10 point improvement in authorization rates.
claims.title: Merchants | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Services: merchant catalogue, reached via acquirer/processor ('Access through virtually every major processor'). Cross-sells to 'Discover Global Network Acquirers and Merchants'.

claims.claim: Support is segmented by partner type with named hotlines and mailboxes: issuer support, Discover Debit issuer support, DebitProtect helpdesk, disputes, processor support and merchant acquirer support.
claims.quote: Processors Processor Support 800-420-2122 processorportal@pulsenetwork.com Disputes Helpdesk disputes@pulsenetwork.com Merchants Merchant Acquirer Support 800-420-2122 merchantacquirersales@pulsenetwork.com
claims.title: Client Support | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Surfaces: support. Also 'PULSE Issuer Support 877-247-8573 pulseaccountmanagement@discover.com', 'Discover ® Debit Issuer Support 877-433-3248', 'DebitProtect ® Helpdesk 866-892-3517 debitprotect@pulsenetwork.com'. No public support portal, status page, bulletins or developer centre found.

claims.claim: The Client Support page names four gated tools behind Log In / Register: PULSE Debit Dashboard, ATM List Manager, Marketing Hub and PULSE Exchange.
claims.quote: PULSE Debit Dashboard ® Monitor the performance of your debit program. Log In / Register > ATM List Manager Log In / Register >
claims.title: Client Support | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Surfaces: gated. Text continues 'Marketing Hub Complimentary marketing materials to optimize your debit program. Log In / Register > PULSE Exchange Log In / Register >'; no description for ATM List Manager or PULSE Exchange.

claims.claim: Registration for the PULSE secure website is form-based and promises a User ID and temporary password within five business days.
claims.quote: Complete and submit your registration form Receive a User ID and temporary password within 5 business days
claims.title: Log In | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Surfaces: login/registration. Not readable without an account beyond this page.

claims.claim: PULSE publishes the acceptance mark files and a PULSE Graphic Standards Manual publicly on the Client Support page, without login.
claims.quote: PULSE Network is the owner of the PULSE acceptance Mark. Protection of the Mark is vital to all network participants,
claims.title: Client Support | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Surfaces: public brand assets (.ai/.png/.jpeg) for North America/Caribbean and International use; 'follow our PULSE Graphic Standards Manual'.

claims.claim: The 2026 PULSE Debit Issuer Study, 'The Next Era of Debit', reports debit transactions up 4.6% YoY, CNP at 50% of debit spend and 17% of transactions via mobile wallets.
claims.quote: Transactions increased 4.6% year-over-year, with active cardholders making 35.4 transactions monthly.
claims.title: 2026 PULSE Debit Issuer Study | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Surfaces: research; report download and webinar (Steve Sievert) via form/on24. Industry figures, not PULSE network figures.

claims.claim: PULSE participates in EMVCo, U.S. Payments Forum, U.S. Faster Payments Council, Secure Technology Alliance, FIDO Alliance, Merchant Advisory Group and W3C as its advocacy alliances.
claims.quote: EMVCo U.S. Payments Forum U.S. Faster Payments Council Secure Technology Alliance FIDO Alliance Merchant Advisory Group World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)
claims.title: About PULSE | PULSE Network
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Reach: alliances/industry bodies. Partner-support page lists a slightly different set (adds American Transaction Processing Coalition, omits STA and W3C).
